features.title: What you get
features.subtitle: Not another game review. A diagnosis.
features.openingLeaksDesc: We track every opening position you reach more than twice and grade the moves you actually play.
features.tacticsDesc: Your missed tactics are not random — they are usually 3 motifs you cannot see.
features.endgamesDesc: How many winning endgames do you actually convert? Most players guess wrong by 40%.
